subject: Sarah's 3AM concert fix
preview_text: One user's story that stopped our team. How she turned a quiet phone into a stadium experience.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, at 3AM, a user named Sarah sent us a message. She was at a friend's apartment, trying to play a live recording from a concert she'd been saving for months. The room was dead quiet, and her phone's speakers were barely a whisper. She told us she almost gave up.

That's when she remembered the boost button. One tap, and suddenly the bass kicked in like she was back in the front row. Her friend, half-asleep, started dancing. Sarah said it felt like her phone had a secret life. We read her email twice.

This is exactly why we built the Bass Booster feature. It's not just about volume—it's about feeling the music. Open the app, tap Bass Booster, and slide it up. You'll hear low-end you didn't know your speakers had. It works system-wide, so every app gets the treatment.

Open Volume Booster - Sound Booster right now. Try Bass Booster on your favorite track. P.S. Sarah told us she now uses it for podcasts too—turns out hearing the host's voice with depth changes everything.
